dict.string: Lowk transcribes what you say during a call (your voice is labelled «Я»). Audio stays on this Mac unless you choose a cloud engine.
Lowk transcribes the sound of the call app you choose (labelled «Система»). Audio stays on this Mac unless you choose a cloud engine.
Lowk takes screenshots you request and adapts its overlay to what's behind it. Lowk's own windows are never included.
